description:
A simulated Decibel exchange on recorded Decibel prices (every minute) and order
        books (20 levels, a snapshot about every 10 minutes since 15 Nov 2026): test a bot's
        order logic without keys or money. Nothing is sent to Decibel. No registration.
        Taker orders consume the recorded levels: what one order takes is gone for the next
        (same step, TP/SL, margin calls) until the next recorded snapshot; beyond the last
        level nothing fills (IOC/market: partial fill, rest cancelled with the reason). The
        book is moved with the mark only when that is worse for the taker (a buy never pays
        less than mark + half the recorded spread), sizes as recorded. With no book recorded
        at that time (before 15 Nov 2026): a synthetic book from the market's median recorded
        book, consumed level by level (mark_capped). Resting limits fill only up to the volume
        traded through their price: recorded trades, or before them the 1-minute candles
        (volume x the share of the candle's range past the price); with neither, they don't
        fill. The clock stops where prices and every market's trades are recorded (a few
        minutes behind now). Each fill says what priced it in priced_by: book, book_shifted,
        mark_capped, trades or candle, and has a fill_id. "fills" (since: ms, limit: up to
        500, after_fill_id: the previous page's cursor) pages through the fill history; step
        already returns every fill of that step in events.
        action="start" (start_hours_ago: where the clock begins, default 6 h ago; maker_fill
        "through" = a resting limit fills only when the price goes through it, default, or
        "touch") returns a session_id to pass to every other action. Then: "place" (market
        e.g. "BTC", side buy|sell, size, price, time_in_force gtc|post_only|ioc|market,
        reduce_only, client_order_id), "cancel" (order_id), "order" (order_id or
        client_order_id: status and Decibel's cancellation reason), "set_leverage" (market,
        leverage), "set_margin_mode" (market, margin_mode cross|isolated), "add_margin"
        (market, amount: isolated only), "set_tpsl" (market, take_profit, stop_loss: needs an
        open position), "step" (minutes: advance the clock; orders are only acknowledged when
        placed and fill or cancel on the next step, like on Decibel), "state" (also
        order_history with reasons, events, liquidation_price, maintenance_margin,
        available_margin), "share" (public read-only copy; api_key shows your handle).
        Decibel's rules apply: tick and lot size, minimum size, max leverage, post-only and IOC
        violations, reduce-only trimming, cross and isolated margin, two-stage liquidation
        (margin call to 105% of maintenance, backstop below 2/3), maker 1.5 / taker 4.5 bps,
        hourly funding. See pitbi.app/sandbox.
name: sandbox
